cli.finalMessage:
Both files pass the audit clean (score 100, no findings).

The screen is built in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- **Four headline stats** (`StatTile`/`StatTileGroup`): Total balance and Rewards points up vs. last month; Monthly spending and Open disputes down (both good news, shown via `positiveIsGood`).
- **Banner**: an `Alert` (tone="warning") about the card ending 4821 expiring next month, with a "Order replacement" contrast action.
- **Recent activity**: a `Card` with the 5 most recent mock transactions, each with an `IconTile` (in/out arrow), description, date/category, and signed amount (colour + sign, never colour alone).

All values/tokens are from `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons`, styled only with `var(--strata-*)` tokens and logical properties, no brand-specific logic. I did not touch `main.tsx`, `app.css`, or config files, and can't run the dev server in this environment to visually verify — you'll want to spin it up and check the four brand/scheme/locale combinations from the README.
